tasks.title: R_eff length-conditioned reject curve (R1; spec 04 Admission decision)
tasks.description: Replace the flat REJECT_COMMON_THRESHOLD=12 rejection in admit() with R_eff(len): flat R for len<=8; R+(255-R)*sqrt((len-8)/12) for 8<len<20; admit-all for len>=20. R is the rejectCommonness-resolved floor; the whole curve scales from it. Attested admissions land at rank group 1 flat (dead MID table row deleted; group 2 kept only for the subword clamp). Both conjugation-guard tiers compare stems against R_eff(len(word)). calibrate-bands.mjs prints R_eff-aware verdicts.

subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: plan/003_bbac3b15e8d0/architecture/r1-admission-reff.md — src/core/score.ts admit() today rejects at flat `q >= rejectAt` where rejectAt = opts.rejectCommonness ?? REJECT_COMMON_THRESHOLD (12); the `else if (q >= MID_FREQ_THRESHOLD) result = 2` table row is dead; RankGroup = 0|1|2 (types.ts:17), group 2 only producible via the subword clamp; q = dictionary.lookup(draft.key), null = absent; knob flows per-call from IngestPipeline (ingest.ts:558-563), default baked at config.ts:91 — no config changes needed.
2. INPUT: CandidateDraft (src/core/types.ts) with .key and .key.length; AdmissionOptions.rejectCommonness (existing optional param).
3. LOGIC: export `rEff(floor: number, len: number): number` (plus REJECT_LEN_FLOOR=8 / REJECT_LEN_FULL=20 constants) from score.ts. admit(): reject iff q !== null && q >= rEff(rejectAt, draft.key.length); DELETE the dead MID table row so every attested admission lands at group 1 flat; q === null stays group 0. CRITICAL EDGE: len >= 20 is admit-all — a naive rEff=255 with `q >= 255` rejects q=255 words; special-case (sentinel 256 or len>=20 short-circuit). Pure function over the dictionary lookup; mock the dictionary with the existing stub-dict test helper (test/score.test.ts `dict(entries)`). TDD (test/score.test.ts): assert RELATIVE to imported constants — floor hold (q>=R rejects at any len<=8), sqrt-ramp boundary probes (q=81 admits / q=82 rejects at 9 chars), admit-all at len>=20 incl. q=255, flat group 1, knob override (e.g. {rejectCommonness:10}) moves floor AND curve. 4. OUTPUT: exported rEff consumed by P1.M1.T1.S2 (guard), P1.M1.T1.S3 (probe), and tests; admit() signature unchanged for ingest.ts callers.

subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:

RESEARCH NOTE: plan/003_bbac3b15e8d0/architecture/r2-path-candidates.md — pass 4 scans LITERAL_RE = /[A-Za-z0-9._@:+/~=-]{4,80}/g (segment.ts:63) — code window is 80, spec says 96: widen to {4,96} IN THIS CHANGE. classifyLiteral (segment.ts:150-190) shows the trim/validate pattern; RawToken/CandidateDraft gain `path?: boolean` mirroring `literal?` (types.ts:83-113); expandCandidates today emits key=raw.toLowerCase(), display=raw (segment.ts:545-546) and returns [whole] for hexish/literal (segment.ts:557-559); rule-3 Unicode adjacency helper isUniLetter/isUniLetterBefore applied per match at segment.ts:461-463; equal-span tokens defer to the existing class (segment.ts:466-468).
2. INPUT: raw literal-charset match + text + index from the pass-4 scan (existing machinery).
3. LOGIC: add classifyPath(raw) sibling of classifyLiteral. Predicate after edge trimming of leading '/', '~', './', '../' (combinations) and trailing '/': >=2 interior single '/' separators OR exactly 1 interior '/' plus a dotted component => ONE opaque token. KEY = trimmed lowercased slice; DISPLAY/token span = ORIGINAL run (first key!=display divergence beyond casing — today literal tokens emit the trimmed slice as raw, path tokens must keep the untrimmed span + trim metadata for the key). Trailing ':digits(:digits)?' trimmed (key+display computation) only when the remainder is path-shaped; non-path colons ('4:36', 'localhost:8080') untouched; one retrim iteration suffices (pin 'a/b.ts:42:13:99' behavior). Guards: interior '..' rejects the WHOLE run ('a/../b' shreds); adjacent interior symbols rejected (reuse classifyLiteral rule); digit-bearing runs qualifying via 4c take the path class when they qualify both ways (emit path:true, literal:false); rule-3 Unicode adjacency at the TRIMMED bounds; strictly additive vs equal spans (paths contain '/' so equal-span collisions with other classes are impossible — keep the guard for symmetry/tests). expandCandidates: path branch emits {key: trimmed.toLowerCase(), display: originalRaw, isSubword:false} and returns [whole] (opaque to subword splitting). TDD per spec 09 (test/segment.test.ts): src/core/query.ts; /home/user/projects/hapax (key trims leading '/', display keeps); docs/architecture.md; ../tools/build.mjs; example.com/a/b; ':line:col' trims; 'and/or' NOT a token; interior '..' rejects whole.

subtasks.title: matchFragment: first-char anchor + greedy subsequence + tiers 3/2/1
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: plan/003_bbac3b15e8d0/architecture/r3-query-fuzzy.md — query.ts (176 lines) never does its own string compare today; matching is implicit via store.prefixRange(lower) (query.ts:107); case handling lowercases the fragment before prefixRange (store throws RangeError on uppercase) and keeps stored display casing; path keys (up to 96 chars, '/'-bearing, from P1.M1.T2) flow through the same scan — spot-check the matcher treats '/' sanely on the candidate side.
2. INPUT: fragment f (string) and candidate key c (string, lowercase store key) from the first-char range scan (P1.M2.T2.S2).
3. LOGIC: export `matchFragment(f: string, c: string): { tier: 1|2|3; score: number } | null` — case-insensitive; anchor f[0]===c[0]; anchored subsequence of f[1..] in c[1..] greedy leftmost (single two-pointer pass; tier 2 detectable as contiguous run during the same pass, or c.indexOf(f.slice(1),1)). Tiers: 3 = exact prefix; 2 = contiguous tail ('zsk' -> 'zendesk', 'zlock' -> 'z_lwlock'); 1 = scattered ('hrp' -> 'handleResponseProxy'). 'esk' NEVER matches 'zendesk' (anchor fails). Retire plain prefix as the only match mode. Score stub may return 0 here if it eases review, but prefer landing S2's arithmetic in the same function. TDD (test/query.test.ts): anchor cases incl. 'esk' never matches 'zendesk'; 'roun' -> 'Rounding' via stored display/subword candidates; tier classification cases above; case-insensitivity.
4. OUTPUT: matchFragment consumed by P1.M2.T1.S2 (scoring/threshold), P1.M2.T2 (ranking + scan), P1.M2.T3.S1 (chain gate), P1.M3.T2.S1 (widget visibility >=1-candidate rule).
5. DOCS: none — JSDoc on the exported matcher rides with the code.

TDD: score arithmetic per tier for each formula; below-threshold never renders; threshold 0 admits everything; default-60-kills-tier-1 pin.
